## Modules

- [aequitas](https://aequitas.hexdocs.pm/aequitas.md): Fairness regulator for Erlang/OTP and Elixir, with optional rate limiting.
- [aequitas_category](https://aequitas.hexdocs.pm/aequitas_category.md): Per-category handler: sliding-window work tracking and outlier detection.
- [aequitas_time_interval](https://aequitas.hexdocs.pm/aequitas_time_interval.md): Time interval type used in category settings.
- [aequitas_work_stats](https://aequitas.hexdocs.pm/aequitas_work_stats.md): Work statistics used for outlier detection.
- [aequitas_work_stats_sup](https://aequitas.hexdocs.pm/aequitas_work_stats_sup.md)
